unit_of_coverage: behavioral capability family, not raw test count

capabilities.success: Accumulated fatigue can make rest win and rest reduces fatigue.
Affiliation pressure can make social approach win and socializing reduces that pressure.
Competence pressure contributes to work selection and work reduces it.
Experienced support/hostility changes later social behavior for the experienced partner without equivalent change for another partner.
Threat experience affects later avoidance after the immediate event and the carryover decays.
Experienced reward changes later choice in the same context without globally biasing unrelated contexts.
Observed reliability/unreliability changes later delegate/verify behavior for that partner.

capabilities.policy: uncertainty policy is causal but has no persistent state and is not counted as a separate persistent mechanism
capabilities.success: Unknown or near-neutral partners are verified without action-order tie artifacts.
Multiple unresolved concerns coexist under the fixed capacity-three bound and stronger current concerns can dominate without overwriting all weaker identities.
An unresolved concern remains represented while activation decays far below the former deletion threshold; cancellation/work still terminate it.
A weaker third unresolved concern remains non-dominant during stronger competition and becomes ordinarily eligible after stronger concerns terminate.
A latent future commitment exerts no ordinary concern pressure before its cue and becomes an ordinary concern when the experienced cue occurs.
Directly observed location is retained and guides search.
A hidden simulator world change does not alter subject-owned location belief or behavior.
A later direct observation revises the subject-owned location fact and changes subsequent search behavior.
An immediate experienced outcome can update the uniquely eligible immediately preceding contextual action without obsolete last-action persistence.
A delayed experienced outcome updates a live uniquely context-matched prior action with age-derived eligibility.
When multiple distinct live actions share the experienced outcome context, the organism abstains rather than inventing a hidden cause.
Changing or invoking presentation does not alter organism decisions or persistent state.
Canonical serialize/destroy/restore preserves subject-owned causal state and continuation behavior.
